mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope(organization_unit_id,include_descendants) AS (SELECT scope_target_id,include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND scope_type='ORGANIZATION' AND active=TRUE UNION SELECT c.organization_unit_id,TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit c JOIN visible_scope p ON c.parent_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.include_descendants=TRUE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.evidence_package(evidence_package_id,consent_response_id,consent_request_id,organization_unit_id,generation_status,queued_at) SELECT #{packageId},#{responseId},#{requestId},organization_unit_id,'QUEUED',#{now} FROM seal.consent_request WHERE consent_request_id=#{requestId} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH picked AS ( SELECT evidence_package_id FROM seal.evidence_package WHERE generation_status='QUEUED' OR (generation_status='PROCESSING' AND locked_at<#{leaseExpiredAt}) ORDER BY queued_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), claimed AS ( UPDATE seal.evidence_package p SET generation_status='PROCESSING',locked_at=#{now},attempt_count=attempt_count+1,row_version=row_version+1 FROM picked WHERE p.evidence_package_id=picked.evidence_package_id RETURNING p.* ) SELECT c.evidence_package_id package_id,c.consent_response_id response_id, c.consent_request_id request_id,c.organization_unit_id organization_id, r.recipient_id,r.request_code,t.template_code,t.template_name, tv.version_number template_version_number,recipient.affiliation_name, recipient.job_title,recipient.recipient_name_ciphertext name_ciphertext, recipient.recipient_email_ciphertext email_ciphertext,recipient.encryption_key_id, r.created_at request_created_at, (SELECT MIN(o.smtp_accepted_at) FROM seal.mail_outbox o WHERE o.consent_request_id=r.consent_request_id AND o.smtp_accepted_at IS NOT NULL) first_sent_at, r.expires_at,s.snapshot_json::text snapshot_json,s.snapshot_hash, res.response_status,res.submitted_at,c.attempt_count,c.row_version FROM claimed c JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN seal.recipient recipient USING(recipient_id) JOIN seal.consent_template t USING(consent_template_id) JOIN seal.consent_template_version tv USING(consent_template_version_id) JOIN seal.consent_request_snapshot s ON s.consent_request_snapshot_id=r.snapshot_id JOIN seal.consent_response res ON res.consent_response_id=c.consent_response_id

SELECT i.item_title||': '||ri.decision FROM seal.consent_response_item ri JOIN seal.consent_request_item i USING(consent_request_item_id) WHERE ri.consent_response_id=#{responseId} ORDER BY ri.item_order
SELECT event_type||' @ '||created_at::text FROM seal.consent_request_event WHERE consent_request_id=#{requestId} ORDER BY created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.evidence_package SET generation_status='FINALIZED',relative_path=#{generated.relativePath},manifest_sha256=#{generated.manifestSha256},manifest_hmac=#{generated.manifestHmac},hmac_key_id=#{generated.hmacKeyId},generator_version='seal-0.1',font_version='Noto Sans KR',finalized_at=#{now},locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE evidence_package_id=#{packageId} AND generation_status='PROCESSING' AND row_version=#{claimedRowVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.evidence_file(evidence_file_id,evidence_package_id,file_type,file_name,relative_path,file_size,sha256,created_at) VALUES(gen_random_uuid(),#{packageId},#{file.type},#{file.fileName},#{file.relativePath},#{file.size},#{file.sha256},#{now}) ON CONFLICT (evidence_package_id,file_type) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.evidence_package SET generation_status='FAILED',failed_at=#{now},locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{code},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE evidence_package_id=#{packageId} AND generation_status='PROCESSING' AND row_version=#{claimedRowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT p.evidence_package_id package_id,p.consent_request_id request_id,r.request_code,COALESCE(snapshot.snapshot_json->>'title','동의서') template_title,r.recipient_id,COALESCE((SELECT count(*)::int FROM seal.consent_response_item response_item WHERE response_item.consent_response_id=p.consent_response_id AND response_item.decision='AGREE'),0) agreed_count,COALESCE((SELECT count(*)::int FROM seal.consent_response_item response_item WHERE response_item.consent_response_id=p.consent_response_id),0) decision_count,p.generation_status status,p.queued_at,p.finalized_at,p.attempt_count,p.last_error_code FROM seal.evidence_package p JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN seal.consent_request_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.consent_request_snapshot_id=r.snapshot_id JOIN visible_scope s ON s.organization_unit_id=p.organization_unit_id p.generation_status=#{status} ORDER BY p.queued_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.evidence_package_id package_id,p.consent_request_id request_id,r.request_code,COALESCE(snapshot.snapshot_json->>'title','동의서') template_title,p.generation_status status,p.relative_path,p.manifest_sha256,p.manifest_hmac,p.hmac_key_id,p.queued_at,p.finalized_at,p.last_error_code FROM seal.evidence_package p JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN seal.consent_request_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.consent_request_snapshot_id=r.snapshot_id JOIN visible_scope s ON s.organization_unit_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.evidence_package_id=#{packageId}

SELECT p.evidence_package_id package_id,p.consent_request_id request_id,r.request_code,COALESCE(snapshot.snapshot_json->>'title','동의서') template_title,p.generation_status status,p.relative_path,p.manifest_sha256,p.manifest_hmac,p.hmac_key_id,p.queued_at,p.finalized_at,p.last_error_code FROM seal.evidence_package p JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN seal.consent_request_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.consent_request_snapshot_id=r.snapshot_id JOIN visible_scope s ON s.organization_unit_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.consent_request_id=#{requestId} ORDER BY p.queued_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT file_type type,file_name,relative_path,file_size size,sha256 FROM seal.evidence_file WHERE evidence_package_id=#{packageId} ORDER BY file_type
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.evidence_package p SET generation_status='QUEUED',queued_at=#{now},locked_at=NULL,failed_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,row_version=row_version+1 FROM visible_scope s WHERE p.organization_unit_id=s.organization_unit_id AND p.evidence_package_id=#{packageId} AND p.generation_status='FAILED'
